confirmation.condition: only after the separately collected pilot passes

failure_policy: first native, resource, integrity or durable publication error stops enrollment; hold actual native file descriptors and their namespace until the external collector has fsynced, independently reopened every byte and acknowledged
kernel_role: 383-MiB fully allocated and hash-rechecked ext4 image on a distinct real HOME device. Both outer code and ancillary physical directory entries together fit the remaining 1 MiB. Recheck the full entry headroom after its allocation and before every native and scored installation.
ordinary_subset: 375-unit Ruff CLI on the historical parent, first feature, return parent, return feature and unchanged feature
primary_change: only the destination of raw receipts after an unchanged blocking Cargo timer completes
route_choice: once, after both source-matched 12-pair parser check and test-build terminals and an independently authorized quiet host
stage_authority: a separate host release tied to both public registrations, the exact selected route and the independent parser terminals
status_at_registration: zero observations for the original and external full CLI designs
